code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows significant hypoxemia, mild anemia, thrombocytopenia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin), and mild renal impairment (creatinine, potassium). There is also evidence of coagulopathy (elevated INR, low PT), and mild monocytosis and basophilia. Findings suggest acute systemic inflammation, possible infection or sepsis, and impaired oxygenation; urgent clinical evaluation is recommended.
